attempts.sql: WITH api AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'auto_ontology/server/models.py' AND name = 'ApiModel' AND kind = 'class'), direct AS (SELECT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN api ON cb.base_symbol_id = api.symbol_id), indirect AS (SELECT ca.class_symbol_id, MIN(ca.depth) AS depth FROM code.class_ancestry ca JOIN api ON ca.ancestor_symbol_id = api.symbol_id WHERE ca.depth >= 2 GROUP BY ca.class_symbol_id) SELECT i.class_symbol_id, i.depth FROM indirect i WHERE i.class_symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT class_symbol_id FROM direct) ORDER BY i.depth, i.class_symbol_id

request:
Which classes inherit from ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/models.py) only indirectly, i.e. through at least one intermediate class of this repository, and do not name ApiModel directly in their class statement? An import alias of ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/responses.py imports it as _Payload) counts as naming ApiModel directly, and a subscripted base such as ListResponse[T] counts as its class. For each, give the class symbol ID and the length of the shortest inheritance chain to ApiModel (2 when the parent class directly subclasses ApiModel).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), depth (integer).
explanation: Finds ApiModel's symbol, then classes whose shortest ancestry chain to it has depth >= 2 (indirect inheritance), excluding classes that directly subclass ApiModel. Returns each such class symbol ID with its minimum depth.
